name: LSA-PLUS 2/10 disconnection module (237A), 10 pairs
source: CommScope data sheet: LSA-PLUS Series 2 family
notes: The standard Krone block for audio, control and comms: 10 pairs, each with a disconnect point between cable and jumper side (test or break with a plug). Printed 0-9; -01 and -06 are other printings. BT type 237A. Front ports are the jumper side.

name: LSA-PLUS 2/10 connection module (237B), 10 pairs
source: CommScope data sheet: LSA-PLUS Series 2 family
notes: As the disconnection module but cable and jumper side are permanently joined. BT type 237B.

name: LSA-PLUS ABS screened disconnection module, 6 pairs + screen
notes: Audio broadcast module: 6 screened pairs, each screen carried through separately to the jumper side so screens are not commoned (avoids earth loops on low-level audio). 15 per 3U frame = 90 circuits. Discontinued.
